company.name: AutoStream
company.tagline: Automated video editing tools for content creators.
company.description: AutoStream is a SaaS platform that uses AI to automate video editing, captioning, and optimization for content creators across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and more.

policies.refund: No refunds after 7 days of purchase.
policies.support: 24/7 support is available only on the Pro plan. Basic plan users get email support only.
policies.trial: A 7-day free trial is available for all new users.
policies.cancellation: You can cancel your subscription at any time. Access continues until the end of your billing period.

faq.question: What platforms does AutoStream support?
faq.answer: AutoStream supports YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Twitter/X.

faq.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
faq.answer: Yes, you can switch plans at any time. Changes take effect on your next billing cycle.

faq.question: Does AutoStream support team collaboration?
faq.answer: Team collaboration features are available on the Pro plan, allowing up to 5 team members.

faq.question: What video formats are supported?
faq.answer: AutoStream supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV input formats. Output is optimized per platform.
